headline: 泰特美術館辦90年代展
context: 泰特英國美術館推出新展《The 90s: Art and Fashion》，由前《i-D》雜誌編輯愛德華．恩尼弗（Edward Enninful）策展，重現英國 1990 年代創意產業與年輕世代交會出的活力。此則為單一來源報導，細節仍待補充。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: An evocative new Tate Britain show captures an era when the UK’s newly flush creative industries teamed up with a generation of skint dreamers to bring the decade into vivid colour Here is Kate Moss, with pink hair splayed across a pillow, her face scrubbed of makeup, her smile sweet and wonky. Sarah Lucas’s Pauline Bunny artwork with its confrontational hosiery on a charity shop chair. Sean Ellis’s collaborative knights-in-grubby-armour shoot with Alexander McQueen. Here are happy ravers, in a club, or saluting the sun as it stretches and yawns over a litter-strewn hill. These photos are old. They were taken a long time ago. But they’re young, too. They are curated by Edward Enninful for the Tate’s exhibition The 90s: Art and Fashion (Enninful worked at i-D in the 90s) and almost everyone involved is shiny and fresh. The models, whether professional or not, are mostly in their 20s, and the photographers are early in their careers. It gives the photos a youthful fizz, a verve. But the energy also comes from an understanding between photographer and subject. In many of the pictures you can feel the shared mischief, a “yes we’re serious about our ideas” but also a “look, we’re getting away with it!” delight. Continue reading...
sources.title: Hard parties, cheap rents and horrible flats: how 90s art and fashion redefined British culture

泰特美術館辦90年代展

泰特英國美術館推出新展《The 90s: Art and Fashion》，由前《i-D》雜誌編輯愛德華．恩尼弗策展，收錄凱特．摩絲、莎拉．露卡斯等人的攝影與作品，重現英國 1990 年代創意產業與年輕世代交會出的活力。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 17 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
泰特英國美術館推出新展《The 90s: Art and Fashion》，由曾任《i-D》雜誌編輯的愛德華．恩尼弗（Edward Enninful）策展。展覽收錄凱特．摩絲、莎拉．露卡斯等人當年的攝影與作品，呈現英國 1990 年代創意產業剛開始富起來、卻仍有一整代窮困夢想家的年代氛圍，展出的照片多半由當時仍在職涯早期的攝影師拍攝，畫面裡能感受到攝影師與被攝者之間那種又認真、又好玩的默契。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 17 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
泰特英國美術館推出一檔 1990 年代主題新展，重現英國創意產業剛開始富起來、卻仍有一整代窮困夢想家的年代氛圍。

展覽由曾任時尚雜誌編輯的愛德華．恩尼弗策展，收錄凱特．摩絲等人當年的攝影作品，畫面裡能感受到攝影師與被攝者之間那種又認真、又好玩的默契。
